title: A stock WordPress robots.txt gets a stated position and the policy in plain words

changes.after:
User-agent: *
Disallow: /wp-admin/
Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php

Sitemap: https://example.com/wp-sitemap.xml

# BEGIN Readiness Index
# Example Co publishes this site for people, and this file says what automated systems may do with it.
# Search engines may crawl these pages and list them in search results.
# AI assistants may read these pages to answer people's questions.
# These pages may not be used to train AI models without a license from Example Co.
# Anyone who wants to use this content in another way should ask for permission first.

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
# END Readiness Index
